description: This file contains minimal React functional components used for building the user interface of a home automation application. The components include layout containers, navigation bar, form fields, buttons, and alert messages, designed to ensure consistency and lightweight rendering.

methods.name: Container({ children })
methods.description: A container component that wraps children content inside a div with 'container' class.

methods.name: Section({ title, subtitle, children, actions })
methods.description: A section component with header, optional subtitle, and optional actions, wrapping children inside a section layout.

methods.name: Navbar
methods.description: Navigation bar component with predefined navigation items for device configuration, control, and status, handling current active selection and navigation callback.

methods.name: Field
methods.description: A form field component with label, optional hint and error messages, wrapping child input elements.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: A styled input element accepting additional properties.

methods.name: TextArea
methods.description: A styled textarea element accepting additional properties.

methods.name: Button
methods.description: A styled button with optional variant prop, defaulting to 'primary'.

methods.name: Alert
methods.description: An alert message component, displaying messages based on type ('info', etc.), only renders if message is provided.

ctags.name: Section
ctags.pattern: /^export function Section({ title, subtitle, children, actions }) {$/
